Every file, method and connection in Assets/_Hollowmere/Scripts/Runtime/AI/ (Senses, Scheduling, Director, Debugging). State of dev on 19 Oct 2026. SE3062 Intelligent Systems.

What our code is built on
Scripts/Runtime/AI/Senses/ · shared by every agent: hearing, sight, memory, the player
Scripts/Runtime/AI/Director/ · World scene > _Director · Utility AI with a stress model

• 1-7 jump to test points, F1 hides the help
• Tagged "Player": the ZoneStreamer loads zones around it
Implements IPlayerState and fakes what the real player will report.
• F flashlight C crouch Q weapon (None / Pistol / IceGun)
• K / L health -/+ 0.2 N use ammo 0.2 M refill ammo
Turns the player's movement into footstep noises.
• No step if speed < 0.5 m/s or in the air
• Running (>= 5 m/s): Loudness.Run 12 m, a step every 0.33 s
• Walking: Loudness.Walk 5 m, a step every 0.5 s
• InWater(): NavMesh area under the feet is "Water" (the flood) -> kind
Test keys and the AI cost line on screen.
• P drop a NoiseProbe O drop a watcher (SensesProbe) J drop a
• G Emit(Gunshot, 45 m) H Emit(Door, 10 m)
• Shows the last noise ("heard by N of M") and: thinkers, thoughts this
Runs every agent's thinking a few times a second, spread across frames.
float ThinkInterval { get; } // 0.2 = five times a second
• Register: the first thought is at a random point in the interval, so
agents never all think on the same frame
• A hidden "AiScheduler" object (DontDestroyOnLoad) calls Tick() in its
1 continue round-robin from where the last frame stopped
2 skip thinkers that are not due yet
3 Think(now - lastThink): the real time since its last thought
• Measures itself with a Stopwatch: LastFrameMilliseconds, PeakMilliseconds,
• Thinkers today: StandInAgent (0.2 s), GameDirector (0.5 s)
Why: 20 agents at 5 Hz = about 2 thoughts per frame, never 20 at once.
• NavMesh.SamplePosition / CalculatePath = A* search on the baked NavMesh
• Agent type 0 = Humanoid (sound, routes); Dog = Biscuit only
• Areas: Walkable cost 1, Water cost 3 (only ground under the flood)
• Humanoid NavMeshes are NOT joined between zones: no sound or route crosses
• NavMeshAgent: walks agents along paths (StandInAgent, zombies)
• SceneManager.sceneLoaded / sceneUnloaded: zones streaming in and out
• OnGUI: labels above agents and the F2 Director view
enum NoiseKind { Footstep, Wading, Gunshot, IceGun, Door, Bark, Groan, Staged }
static class Loudness: metres of WALKING distance at which a normal ear still hears it
CrouchStep 2 · Walk 5 · Wade 9 · Door 10 · Run 12 · IceGun 15 · Groan 20 · Bark 25 · Gunshot 45
readonly struct Noise { Vector3 Position; float Loudness; NoiseKind Kind; GameObject Source; }
A struct: emitting a noise makes no garbage, and no listener can change it for the others.
Delivers each noise to the listeners that can hear it. Pushed when it happens; nobody polls.
int Emit(Vector3 position, float loudness, NoiseKind kind, GameObject source)
event Action<Noise, int> Emitted int ListenerCount
Emit(), for every listener (looped backwards so OnHeard may unregister):
1 reach = loudness x listener.HearingAcuity (0 = deaf: skip)
2 cheap cull: straight-line distance > reach -> skip (a path is never shorter than a straight line)
5 after the loop: Emitted(noise, heardBy) -> the Director listens to this
• NavMeshQueryFilter agent type 0 (Humanoid). Without it Unity cannot choose between the Humanoid and Dog NavMeshes
• SamplePosition within 3 m at both ends. Off the NavMesh (a ghost in a wall) -> straight line x 1.5
• CalculatePath (A*). Route incomplete -> infinity (not heard). Else the sum of the corner-to-corner lengths
• Reuses one NavMeshPath and one 64-corner array: no allocation per noise
Result: walls muffle sound (it travels round through doorways), and no sound crosses into another zone.
All static lists are cleared at the start of Play ([RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod]). Also used by Biscuit (smell) and the Director
Vector3 EarPosition // at the feet, on the floor
float HearingAcuity // 1 normal, 1.6 the creature, 0 deaf
void OnHeard(in Noise noise, float pathDistance)
Implemented by: StandInAgent, SensesProbe, NoiseProbe, BiscuitAgent, ZombieMemory (zombie PRs)
Pattern: Register in OnEnable, Unregister in OnDisable. When a zone unloads, its listeners drop out by themselves.

The eyes. Each agent shows its own values in the Inspector.
viewRange 20 m viewAngle 110° (whole cone) detectRate 2/s forgetRate 0.5/s eyeHeight 1.7 m blockers
bool Tick(Transform owner, IPlayerState player, float deltaTime) // true = seen
1 distance <= viewRange 2 angle to the player <= viewAngle / 2
3 Physics.Raycast from the eyes to the player's chest (1.2 m); a hit more than 0.6 m short of the player = blocked
Fill(): the detection meter (recognising takes time)
rate = detectRate x lightFactor x (1 - (d / viewRange)^2) x posture // crouching 0.5
• In view: Meter += rate x dt (max 1). Out of view: Meter -= forgetRate x dt
• Dark, standing (tested): 4 m -> 1.7 s, 10 m -> 2.2 s, 18 m -> 9 s, 25 m -> never. Flashlight on: 3.3 x faster

"I think the player is here": confidence fades
Holds the agent's single best Belief (Belief.cs).
• A new clue replaces the belief only if it is at least as
convincing as the old one NOW: a footstep never overrides a
• Gives up after tau x ln(c0 / 0.1): Seen 18 s · Heard 14 s · Told
Paces the game: decides when, where and how many of the dormant dead wake. On _Director in the World scene.
thinkInterval 0.5 s maxAwake 12 considerRadius 50 m interceptAhead 10 m stagedLoudness 20 m
1 count DirectableRegistry: dormant, awake, and awake within 25 m of the player
5 every 3 s: route.Plan(player -> nearest ZoneExit_ marker); playerAlong = route.Project(player)
6 build DirectorSituation { Stress, Target, Quietness, SecondsSinceLastEvent, DormantCount, AwakeCount, MaxAwake
7 only when target > stress: FindCandidates() -> ScoreCandidate() for each dormant enemy, keep the best 3
9 record stress and target for the F2 graph (last 60 s)
ScoreCandidate = distance x hidden x (0.4 + 0.6 x ahead)
• distance: walking distance (PathDistance). 1 between 15 and 35 m, falling to 0 at 8 m and at 50 m
• hidden: 0.2 if the player can see it (within 60° of their look + raycast), otherwise 1
• ahead: (1 if ahead of the player on the route, 0.3 if behind) x closeness to the route (full within 6 m, 0 at
• WakeDead(): wakes 1 to 3 (more when far below the target): candidate.WakeToward(route point 10 m ahead)
• StageNoise(): a point halfway between the best sleeper and the route ahead -> NoiseSystem.Emit(Staged, 20 m).
• OnNoise(): noises within 2 m of the player (not Staged) -> profile.RecordNoise(loudness, isGunshot)
It never moves an enemy and never tells one where the player is. The enemies' own senses do the rest.
How tense the player is, 0 to 1.
fall = 0.05 x dt (only if no enemy near)
Tested: 2 s with 2 enemies 0.16 · -20 % health 0.50 · 10 s
The tension the Director aims for (a feedback loop).
Relax: 0.15, until 35 s passed and stress <= 0.30 (or
Target and Phase are read every think.
Learns the play style from the player's own noise.
Moving averages over 30 s: NoiseRate, ShotsPerMinute
Predicts the player's way to the zone exit.
Plan(from, goal) // A* on the Humanoid NavMesh
Project(p, out lateral) -> metres along route
Exits: Z1 EstateGate, Z2 Undercroft, Z3 Waterworks.
Scores every action 0 to 1 and picks the highest. Each score is a PRODUCT, so any single 0 vetoes it.
need = clamp01((target - stress) / 0.4) excess = clamp01((stress - target) / 0.3)
rested = clamp01((sinceLastEvent - 5) / (15 - 5)) // a hard 5 s gap between events
available = dormant > 0 and awake < maxAwake ? 1 : 0 room = 1 - awake / maxAwake
WakeDead = need x rested x available x room x best x (1 - 0.5 x quietness)
StageNoise = need x rested x available x best x (0.3 + 0.7 x quietness)
Tested: calm + loud player -> Wake 0.86 · calm + stealthy -> Stage 0.84 · stress above target -> Hold 1.00 · no
dead left or all in plain sight -> Hold

ONE MOMENT IN THE VILLAGE: what runs, in order
Example: the player fires a gun near three sleeping dead, then escapes. Read left to right, then the second row.
NoiseSystem loops the listeners. Straight-line > 45 m:
PathDistance: A* on the Humanoid NavMesh. Around walls,
Within 0.2 s the AiScheduler runs the agent's Think: belief
On the way, SightSensor.Tick: in range, in cone, ray clear,
Director Think: 2 awake within 25 m -> stress rises; at 0.75
the curve goes Peak, then Relax -> HoldBack.
Player breaks line of sight. Beliefs fade (Seen gives up after
18 s) -> the dead fall Dormant again.
Relax ends, BuildUp: target > stress -> Director scores hidden
sleepers ahead on the route -> WakeToward / StageNoise.
TensionCurve target (white line on dark) and measured stress (red). The Director acts to close the gap.
Time (s) 0 to 200 · stress rises when the dead are near or the player is hurt, and falls at 0.05/s when nothing is near · the 5 s minimum gap keeps events apart
Senses/ Noise · NoiseSystem · INoiseListener · PlayerNoiseEmitter · IPlayerState
• Brain = plain C# (decides); body = one MonoBehaviour (senses in, NavMeshAgent / animation events out)
• Register in OnEnable, Unregister in OnDisable (NoiseSystem, AiScheduler, DirectableRegistry)
• Think through the AiScheduler; never search the scene or allocate inside a thought
• Check PlayerRegistry.Current for null; enemies see the player only through SightSensor
• All AI together under 2 ms per frame on the RTX 2050 laptop
